story_type: plane ditches far offshore, eleven survivors in a life raft, rescue kit drop and basket hoists
hook: Their plane went down 80 miles off Florida. Eleven survived.
narration: Eleven people in a life raft, eighty miles off Florida.
Their twin engine turboprop had gone down in the Atlantic after an engine failure.
Its beacon alerted the Coast Guard. Search planes found them.
From the open ramp of an HC-130J, Airmen dropped a rescue kit to the survivors.
That kit is rafts and supplies joined by a long line, easy to grab from the water.
A helicopter crew on a training mission was redirected to the raft.
[short pause] One by one, they hoisted all eleven.
outcome: All eleven were flown out in stable condition.
title: Plane went down, 11 in a life raft
description:
A twin-engine turboprop went down about 80 miles east of Melbourne, Florida, on May 12, 2026. An Air Force HH-60W crew from the 920th Rescue Wing hoisted all 11 survivors from a life raft.

Footage: U.S. Air Force video, 920th Rescue Wing, via DVIDS: https://www.dvidshub.net/video/1006722/920th-rescue-wing-assists-rescue-11-survivors-off-florida-coast
